title: Planetary technosignature magnitudes for all ten scenarios
transcriptionMethod: Manual transcription from the PDF table, checked against a rendered page and layout-preserving text extraction.
nullSemantics: A null transcribes the table's dash: the technosignature has no reported magnitude for that body and scenario. Null must not be silently converted to numeric zero.
assumptions: Relative quantities use Earth 2024 as the reference value.
Surface modification is a fraction of total planetary surface.
notes: Mars industrial pollution in S5 and S6 includes artificial greenhouse gases for terraforming.
Venus industrial pollution in S5 and S6 indicates O2 production and depletion of other constituents for terraforming.
Every row descriptor, annotation field, and scenario magnitude/null carries an exact Table 6 row/column locator.

annotations: S5 and S6 include artificial greenhouse gases for terraforming Mars.
S5 and S6 indicate O2 production and depletion of other constituents for terraforming Venus.
